bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
src=a1b687d2982b05f6358974bc428a63a909f98ed1
stage="$root/.worktrees/shared-menu-a1b687d-20261115"
test -d "$root" || exit 60
test "$(git -C "$root" remote get-url origin | sed -E 's#^git@github.com:#https://github.com/#')" = "https://github.com/seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot.git" || exit 61
mkdir -p "$root/.worktrees"
if [ -e "$stage" ]; then
 test "$(git -C "$stage" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$src" || exit 62
else
 git -C "$root" fetch --no-tags origin "$src" >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 63
 test "$(git -C "$root" rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = "$src" || exit 64
 git -C "$root" worktree add --detach "$stage" "$src" >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 65
fi
test -z "$(git -C "$stage" status --porcelain)" || exit 66
test -f "$stage/artifacts/bot/src/services/postingMenuContract.ts" || exit 67
test -f "$stage/docs/GAYBBS_SHARED_UI_RUNTIME_MAPPING.md" || exit 68
docker build --network host --pull=false -f "$stage/artifacts/bot/deploy/Dockerfile.gaybbs" -t gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:shared-a1b687d "$stage" >/tmp/gace-shared-menu-build-a1b.log 2>&1 || exit 69
docker run --rm --network none --pull never --entrypoint node gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:shared-a1b687d --check /app/gaybbs.mjs >/dev/null || exit 70
echo SHARED_MENU_SOURCE_SHA="$src"
echo SHARED_MENU_IMAGE_STAGE=PASS
echo EXISTING_BOT_NOT_RESTARTED=YES
